chunks: Al-Tabarani was a shaykh from the Zaydiyyah. A discussion occurred with him through a young man from the children of the Ansar who used to visit the shaykh and learn from him.

key_terms.أَوْلَادِ ٱلْأَنْصَارِ: the descendants or children of the Ansar
key_terms.ٱلزَّيْدِيَّةِ: the Zaydiyyah, the group to which the shaykh is attributed
key_terms.ٱلشَّيْخِ: the shaykh or teacher to whom the youth would go
key_terms.ٱلطَّبَرَانِيُّ: Al-Tabarani, the individual being identified in the report

ai.seo_question: Who was involved in the exchange with al-Tabarani, and what was the role of the young man from the Ansar?
ai.summary: This report briefly identifies al-Tabarani as a shaykh affiliated with the Zaydiyyah and mentions an exchange involving him. The exchange took place through a young man from the descendants of the Ansar who regularly attended the shaykh and studied with him.
